intuition: For each subsequence length, retain the smallest possible ending value to leave room for future values.

brute_force.approach: Enumerate subsequences and keep the longest strictly increasing one.

optimal.approach: Maintain patience-sorting tails and binary-search the first tail not smaller than each value.

edge_cases: Equal values replace a tail and do not increase strict LIS length.
The tails array is not itself necessarily a subsequence.
